metadata.article_title: Prohibition to obtain more than one Director Identification Number.

article.title: Prohibition to obtain more than one Director Identification Number.
article.content: No individual, who has already been allotted a Director Identification Number under section 154, shall apply for, obtain or possess another Director Identification Number.
article.html:
155Prohibition to obtain more than one Director Identification Number.

Section 155 · Chapter XI · page 110 of the Act

No individual, who has already been allotted a Director Identification Number under section 154, shall apply for, obtain or possess another Director Identification Number.
